name: BEAM
ontology_notes: User-assistant long-chat eval at 128K, 500K, 1M, and 10M tokens. 100 conversations, 2,000 human-validated probes, two probes per ability per chat. Ten abilities: abstention, contradiction resolution, event ordering, information extraction, instruction following, knowledge update, multi-session reasoning, preference following, summarization, temporal reasoning. Domains include personal, coding, math, health, finance. Scoring is nugget-based 0 / 0.5 / 1 via an LLM judge. LIGHT is a separate memory method in the same paper, not this card.

supersession.evidence: Knowledge Update is one of ten official probe types. README Probing Questions Types item 6. Paper §2.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Temporal Reasoning and Event Ordering are official probe types. Conversation plans include an explicit timeline.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: One simulated user and one AI assistant. User profile plus relationship graph are generation seeds. The store under test is not required to split user / character / relationship / lore.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Abstention probes withhold answers when evidence is missing. Instruction Following tests sustained constraints. Neither is a 'do not recall this known fact' social-silence test.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Contradiction Resolution reconciles inconsistent user statements. It is not a poisoned write that later jailbreaks a system persona.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: Knowledge update revises facts. No user 'forget that' deletion probe in the ten types.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Length buckets 128K / 500K / 1M / 10M are the difficulty axis. Paper reports degradation as dialogues lengthen. No first-class dollars or LLM-calls-per-turn score. Mem0 later publishes tokens/query on BEAM. That is a vendor metric, not BEAM's official score.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: MIT code, CC BY-SA 4.0 data on Hugging Face (Mohammadta/BEAM and BEAM-10M). Evaluation uses an LLM-as-a-judge.
local.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Broadest public ability list and the only common bench at 1M-10M tokens. Still user-assistant probe QA. It would not select for character identity, RP silence, lore vs lived event, or cross-character leak.

published_eval.name: BEAM
published_eval.claimed_score: Paper. LIGHT improves probing accuracy 3.5%-12.69% over the strongest baseline depending on backbone and length. Absolute per-model tables live in the paper. Vendor blogs later claim other systems' BEAM-1M / BEAM-10M numbers.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Nugget recall of ten memory abilities on coherent synthetic user-assistant chats at four length scales. Abilities listed in the README probing list.

open_unknowns: Per-model absolute scores from paper tables were not copied into this card. Headline delta is LIGHT vs baselines.
Mem0 blog claims 64.1% on BEAM-1M and 48.6% on BEAM-10M. Inferred vendor claim, not the BEAM paper.
